UnitDialog.peasant:
Give me a patch of dirt and I'll turn it into dinner.
Farms don't plow themselves, you know!
UnitDialog.runner:
Fast feet, faster deliveries!
If it needs moving urgently, I'm already halfway there!
UnitDialog.settler:
We're new here!
Every great city starts with people like us!
UnitDialog.vendor:
Fresh goods! Fair prices!
I keep the market buzzing and the people smiling.
UnitDialog.tax_collector:
Relax, it's for the good of the city!
I turn coins into roads, guards, and very official-looking paperwork.
UnitDialog.water_carrier:
No water, no life!
I keep homes supplied and everyone pleasantly un-thirsty.
UnitDialog.guard:
Stay calm, citizen.
I handle trouble so you can handle prosperity.
UnitDialog.teacher:
Knowledge today, greatness tomorrow!
I turn young minds into productive citizens.
UnitDialog.actor:
Drama! Comedy! Mildly exaggerated historical events!
I keep morale high and boredom low.
UnitDialog.monk:
Peace, wisdom, and the occasional miracle.
I nurture the spirit of the city.
UnitDialog.medic:
Coughing? Limping? Mildly on fire?
I'll patch you up and get you back to work!
UnitDialog.bird:
Chirp! I see everything from up high.
Consider me your unofficial aerial surveillance.

Story.stele.dragon_legacy.title: The Deeds of the Governor of the South
Story.stele.dragon_legacy.closing: The dragon rose from the river, and the river remembered.
Story.stele.temple_mountain.title: The Works of Lady Sovanna
Story.stele.temple_mountain.closing: Stone is patient. What we build in stone forgives us.
Story.stele.ten_thousand_temples.title: The Merit of Thiha the Scribe
Story.stele.ten_thousand_temples.closing: Merit is not counted in gold, but in what remains when the gold is gone.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.1.stele: In the first year, Khai Sơn raised Phù Sa from the empty flood plain.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.1.lead_in: The river had emptied the plain, and the court sent him to fill it.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.1.briefing:
The Emperor sends Khai Sơn south with a few dozen settlers, seed rice and a governor's seal, to the plain the Sông Son flooded and left empty. Master Văn Lễ rides beside him on the ox cart.

Lay roads from the river landing, mark out houses and dig wells, and the settlers will come. Plant rice and fill the granary first: a city begins with a full granary, not a wall.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.2.stele: He drew fish from the sea and clay from the shore at Bến Gốm.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.2.lead_in: Where the river meets the sea, the nets come up full and the clay is red.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.2.briefing:
Downriver, where the Sông Son meets the sea, the fishing village of Bến Gốm lives on its nets and the red clay of its shore. The court wants the first taxes of the south.

Put the villagers to work at the wharves and the kilns, keep the storage yards stocked, and fill the treasury. The tax caravan the court is waiting for will tell it what kind of governor it sent.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.3.stele: In the valley of spirits, the villages of Thần Khê came to his shrines.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.3.lead_in: In the valley of spirits, every karst tower has its guardian.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.3.briefing:
Inland, among the karst towers, the villages of Thần Khê trust their guardian spirits more than a stranger from court. Their communal hall is older than the Dragon Line.

Honour their shrines before you raise your own office. Grow the valley's town and fill its treasury, and the villages will come to you of their own will.
Story.mission.test_choices.1.stele: Test: at Phù Sa the first seal was set in the river mud.
Story.mission.test_choices.1.lead_in: Test: a seal, a stake and a riverbank.
Story.mission.test_choices.1.briefing: A hidden test mission that only automation reaches. Settle a few people to meet its goal.
Story.mission.test_choices.2.stele: Test: at Hội Thủy the harbour opened to the southern sea.
Story.mission.test_choices.2.lead_in: Test: two harbours, and one choice.
Story.mission.test_choices.2.briefing: A hidden test mission whose world map offers two sites, Hội Thủy and Vân Cảng. This is Hội Thủy.
Story.mission.test_choices.3.stele: Test: at Vân Cảng the island harbour opened instead.
Story.mission.test_choices.3.briefing: The choice's other site, the island harbour of Vân Cảng: a hidden test mission.
Story.mission.test_choices_kambara.1.stele: Test: the Lotus Gate was opened on the lake shore.
Story.mission.test_choices_kambara.1.briefing: A hidden test mission with no goals: it's finished at once, to show Kambara's debrief and the world map's choice.
Story.mission.test_choices_kambara.2.stele: Test: the bay port paid the sea its tribute.
Story.mission.test_choices_kambara.2.lead_in: Test: the bay port, or the pepper hills.
Story.mission.test_choices_kambara.2.briefing: A hidden test mission whose world map offers the mockup's two sites, the bay port and the pepper hills. This is the bay port.
Story.mission.test_choices_kambara.3.stele: Test: the pepper hills sent their harvest down to the coast.
Story.mission.test_choices_kambara.3.briefing: The choice's other site, the pepper hills: a hidden test mission.
Story.mission.test_choices_tampadesa.1.stele: Test: the copper road was cleared to the hills.
Story.mission.test_choices_tampadesa.1.lead_in: Test: the road, the hills and the copper.
Story.mission.test_choices_tampadesa.1.briefin: A hidden test mission with no goals: it's finished at once, to show Tampadesa's debrief and the world map's choice.
Story.mission.test_choices_tampadesa.2.stele: Test: the royal port took in the ships of Hamsara.
Story.mission.test_choices_tampadesa.2.lead_in: Test: the royal port, or the upriver town.
Story.mission.test_choices_tampadesa.2.briefin: A hidden test mission whose world map offers the mockup's two sites, the royal port and the upriver town. This is the royal port.
Story.mission.test_choices_tampadesa.3.stele: Test: the upriver town grew rich on the river trade.
Story.mission.test_choices_tampadesa.3.briefin: The choice's other site, the upriver town: a hidden test mission.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.1.threats: Fire, in a village of thatch and timber.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.2.threats: Debt, if the wages outrun the taxes.
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.3.new.2: A town of a hundred households
Story.mission.dragon_legacy.3.threats: Fire and collapse, as the town grows close.
Story.briefing.test.new: Test: a house and a resident
Story.briefing.test.threats: Test: none but the test itself.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_a.1.bubble_1: He is not of the Dragon Line.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_a.1.narration: Not born of the Dragon Line, yet raised beneath the royal sun.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_a.2.bubble_1: Your father died protecting this realm. I have raised you in his honour.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_a.3.bubble_1: Honour is inherited, Father. Not borrowed.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_a.4.bubble_1: Go south, to the plains the river has emptied. Build there — not for me, but for those who will live there. Let your works answer the court.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_a.5.bubble_1: I will build not for power, but for the people.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_a.5.narration: To silence doubt, he was sent where the wilderness meets destiny.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_a.6.bubble_1: From this land, a new heritage shall rise.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_a.6.narration: A leader is forged not by blood, but by what he creates.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_a.title: Adopted, Yet Chosen
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_b.2.bubble_1: Governor, thank you for giving us a future!
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_b.2.bubble_2: This prosperity belongs to you, the people.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_b.3.bubble_1: The court asked what blood you carry. The river has answered.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_b.4.bubble_1: The people sing his name in the south, Highness. Soon they will sing it in the capital.
Story.story.dragon_legacy.i_b.title: The Governor of the South
